parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the cabinet, made of plywood panels forming the sides, back, and top.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and defines the overall shape and stability of the cabinet, holding the base and door in place.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that supports other components.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom platform of the cabinet, made of plywood, supporting the weight of stored items.
parts.Functional_description: It distributes the load evenly and provides a stable foundation for the cabinet to stand on.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part that does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a front panel made of MDF, attached to the frame with hinges and equipped with a handle.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the cabinet’s interior and protects stored items from dust and damage.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close, providing access to the storage space.
